ns0:svg.ns0:title: Quick Combat Drill

ns0:g.aria-label: Not endorsed by Toei Animation or Funimation
When entering Combat as the defender,
you may put the bottom card of your discard
pile into your hand. If you do, draw 1 fewer
card in your Defender Draws 3 Cards phase.
